title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-taylor-hart-2026-03-31
content:
Release train weekly prep notes — 2026-03-31
Owner: Taylor Hart (release engineer)
Attendees (expected): Samir Patel, Maya Singh, Priya Kapoor, Ethan Park, Aisha Rahman (SRE), Jordan Lee (Product), Oliver Chen (QA lead)

Purpose: Quick sync to confirm go/no-go status for Release v1.12.0 (target prod push 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC). Surface any last-minute blockers, confirm owners and action items, and lock the rollout playbook.

High-level release summary:
- Release version: v1.12.0 (inference runtime + canary autoscaler improvements + console rollout controls)
- Target prod push: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (maintenance window confirmed)
- Canary plan: 5% region-us-west-2 for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if metrics stable
- Rollback plan: instant rollback to v1.11.3 with warm pools; auto-fallback policy enabled

Go/No-Go checklist (current status – GREEN/AMBER/RED):
1) QA signoff (end-to-end smoke + critical flows): AMBER
   - Owner: Oliver Chen
   - Notes: Two intermittent failure flakes in multi-region rerouting tests (test ids: smoke-231, smoke-234). Investigating root cause; mitigation available (force single-region routing) if unresolved before canary.

2) Regression/Performance tests (latency p95, throughput): GREEN
   - Owner: Ethan Park
   - Notes: Benchmarks on staging (2048-token median) show p95 within SLO (+5% headroom). CPU/GPU utilization expected to be within reserved capacity.

3) Infra & Capacity (GPU pools, autoscaler config, network): GREEN
   - Owner: Samir Patel
   - Notes: Dedicated pool provisioning complete; autoscaler config validated in dry-run. Cloud quotas confirmed.

4) DB & Migrations (schema changes, config): GREEN
   - Owner: Priya Kapoor
   - Notes: No DB migrations in this release. Feature flags toggled via FF service.

5) Security & Compliance (KMS keys, audit logging): GREEN
   - Owner: Aisha Rahman
   - Notes: Key rotations done; audit export validated.

6) Console + UX docs (release notes, runbook): AMBER
   - Owner: Jordan Lee + Docs team
   - Notes: Draft release notes ready; runbook updated but needs final sanity check for rollback steps and on-call paging matrix.

7) Observability & Alerts (dashboards, SLOs, alert thresholds): GREEN
   - Owner: Maya Singh
   - Notes: Dashboards created; alert thresholds verified with on-call. Alert routing to #oncall-release and PagerDuty configured.

8) Legal/Customer comms: GREEN
   - Owner: Customer Success (TBD)
   - Notes: Scheduled customer notification template in Confluence.

Risks & Blockers (highlighted):
- QA flakes (smoke-231, smoke-234) could delay go decision if not resolved by EOD 2026-03-31. Owner: Oliver Chen. Contingency: run canary with single-region routing and increase monitoring retention.
- Minor console UX doc ambiguity around forced-fallback behavior. Owner: Jordan Lee. Contingency: add explicit note in release notes and runbook for operators.

Action items (owner, due):
- Investigate and triage smoke-231/234 flakes — Oliver Chen — due 2026-03-31 17:00 UTC (update in meeting)
- Finalize runbook rollback steps + paging matrix — Jordan Lee / Docs — due 2026-03-31 18:00 UTC
- Post final perf snapshot from staging to shared dashboard — Ethan Park — due 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC
- Confirm autoscaler dry-run results and finalize config commit — Samir Patel — due 2026-03-31 18:30 UTC
- Prepare customer notification draft for launch — Priya Kapoor / CS — due 2026-03-31 19:00 UTC
- Add explicit operator note about forced-fallback in release notes — Taylor Hart — due 2026-03-31 19:00 UTC

Meeting agenda (30 min):
- 0-5m: Quick status round (owners give GREEN/AMBER/RED)
- 5-15m: Discuss blockers and mitigation plans (focus: QA flakes)
- 15-20m: Confirm canary schedule + rollback triggers
- 20-25m: Communications (internal + customer) and runbook signoff
- 25-30m: Final go/no-go vote and contingency checklist assignment

Decision criteria for go: All critical items (QA signoff OR mitigations in place, Infra capacity, Observability) must be GREEN or have an accepted mitigation; no unresolved P0/P1 issues.

Pre-meeting asks (please complete before 16:00 UTC 2026-03-31):
- Owners: post the latest test run links and highlight any test flakes in the meeting thread.
- QA: post root-cause progress if flakes persist.
- Docs/Product: confirm runbook link and which engineers are on-call for the maintenance window.

Links & artifacts:
- Runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Release+v1.12.0+Runbook
- QA test runs: https://internal-ci.redwood.ai/job/rel-v1.12.0-smoke/
- Perf dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rel-v1-12-0/perf-staging
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2145
- JIRA tickets: RTR-457 (autoscaler), RTR-489 (reroute fixes), RTR-502 (canary metrics)

Post-meeting follow-ups: capture final go/no-go decision and update Confluence runbook + notify #releases and customer success with launch timing and known risks.

Next sync: 2026-04-01 00:30 UTC (30 min) — to confirm final pre-prod checks before push window.

Notes to self: keep the go vote tight; if QA flakes are still intermittent but mitigations are solid we can proceed with canary and short feedback loop. Ensure on-call rota is paged with the right escalation order.
